name: Liam Murphy
source:
A footballer by creed, Liam is Shuyaku best mate. He moved to London at the age of 10, getting drafted to the prestigious Hyde Colligate Institute's football team.

Liam is the kind of guy that everybody likes. He may not be the most intelligent but he is always loyal and supportive of others and that has always given him a signature charm.

Liam, Shuyaku, Saki and , Aemilia, have made up a pair of four for quite some time. However, unbeknownst to Aemilia, Liam has a crush on her and only Shuyaku knows of this.

What adventures are Liam and the others in store for? Only time will tell.
